EXAMPLE RECORD (invented "Acme Orders" domain).

## Decision

The 30-day refund window after delivery in BC-003 applies to every good, digital goods included. There is no separate rule for digital goods: no shorter window and no refusal once a download has started. The VS-003 working assumption "digital goods are excluded until answered" is lifted.

## Context

Decided on 2026-11-20 by the owner, who holds the product owner, tech lead and privacy roles, in answer to BQ-001, as product owner.

## History

- 2026-11-20: decided by the owner as product owner; recorded by documentation-curator from the owner's answer in the session.
